data.name: Info Edge (India) Ltd
data.about: Info Edge is India’s premier online classified company with a portfolio of brands. It owns various brands in different fields like naukri.com (online recruitment), 99acres.com (online real estate), jeevansathi.com (online matrimonial) as well as shiksha.com (online education information services). It also acts as an investor and has invested in many start-ups in the online space and is actively growing its investment portfolio.[1]

data.what_it_does: Info Edge (India) Limited operates web portals and online classified media across four verticals—Recruitment, Real Estate, Matchmaking, and Education—serving corporate clients and consumers in India and select international markets. Its platforms, led by Naukri, deliver market-leading online classifieds and related services.

bull.text: The company delivers strong profitability with TTM revenue of ₹3,473 Cr and PAT of ₹2,213 Cr, while operating margin has expanded dramatically from 14.8% to 36.1% over three years.
Management targets aggressive growth in 99acres, aiming to double billings from ₹497 Cr within three years, achieve 60% market share, and reach 25-30% EBITDA margin.

The Job Hai vertical shows high upside potential, with management planning to more than double revenue from ₹15 Cr and scale to ₹100 Cr in 2-3 years, eventually reaching 10-15% of Naukri India's size.

bear.text: Despite high operating margins, capital efficiency remains weak with ROCE at only 3%, indicating poor returns on invested capital.
Cash conversion is low, with operating cash flow at just 0.72x PAT over three years, raising concerns about earnings quality.
Management's ambitious growth targets lack delivery track record, with the 100% YoY growth goal achieving only 11.8% in 2 of 4 quarters so far.
